report_topic: Welfare of Building and Other Construction Workers in Goa
observations_summary: The audit found significant delays in framing rules, constituting committees, and conducting meetings, leading to low registration of establishments and construction workers. It also revealed issues with cess assessment, collection, and remittance, poor financial management of the welfare fund, and deficient implementation of welfare schemes, including non-implementation of major schemes and irregularities in training and toolkit distribution.
